name: International League of Conservation Photographers (iLCP)
summary: Sponsors conservation photography and film projects of its own Associate and Senior Fellows, anywhere in the world. Media only.

evidence.quote: Most large donors in the United States require their funds to go through a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. This allows the donors to receive a tax break for donations. iLCP can serve the role of that tax-exempt non-profit for our photographers

Can take place anywhere in the world
